title: Four-dimensional molecular mapping from a spatial snapshot reveals the dynamics of hair follicle organogenesis.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Retrieved the PMC full-text XML (PMC13379681) via NCBI efetch and read the Data and code availability section: new data (pseudotime, coordinates, processed expression, decoded in situ sequencing) are 'available upon request'. Searched GEO for '3DEEP' (phrase not found) and Zenodo for '3DEEP hair follicle' (no matching record). Europe PMC supplementary files endpoint returned no zip.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Everything about the dataset (hundreds of follicles, 85- and 228-gene in situ sequencing panels, nude-mouse comparison). The only public accession, GSE131498, is an external 2020 scRNA-seq dataset (Joost et al.), not this paper's data.

a1_downloadable.note: Paper states the new spatial data and code are available upon request from the lead contact; no GEO, Zenodo or supplement deposit found. Checked in the full-text XML and by repository search.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Not checked (no files). The natural label, follicle developmental age, is itself inferred by the authors from molecular state (pseudotime), so it would be constructed.

a5_enough_rows.note: Paper says 'hundreds' of follicles; no count verified.

a6_fits_laptop.note: Not checkable; raw 3D imaging data would likely be large.

a8_label_provenance.note: Developmental age is a pseudotime ordering computed from the same expression features, so predicting it from expression would be circular.

honest_claim_h3: Not reached: data are available only on request.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use 3D spatial gene-expression maps of single hair follicles to predict each follicle's developmental stage and detect delayed development in hairless mice.
plain_idea.train_on: Per-follicle 3D in situ sequencing measurements of a few hundred marker genes from newborn mouse skin; number of follicles unknown ('hundreds' per the paper).
plain_idea.predict: Follicle developmental age, which the authors infer from molecular state rather than measure directly, plus wild-type versus Foxn1-deficient nude genotype.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Developmental biologists could stage organs from a single snapshot; but the data cannot be obtained without a request to the authors.

ml_idea: Predict follicle developmental stage or genotype from 3D spatial transcriptomic profiles; blocked because data are on request only and the stage label is a pseudotime derived from the same features.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; no data available to size.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Data availability statement already kills it: new data 'available upon request'.

verdict_reason: A1 fails: the paper's new spatial data and code are available only on request (stated in the full text; no GEO/Zenodo deposit found), and the developmental-age label is a pseudotime computed from the expression features (A8).
